report.summary: The report's sourcing is generally sound. Most claims are directly supported by the cited excerpts. Two tags (2 and 3) are partial because the excerpts confirm the entity names but not the specified roles; these are minor and could be fixed by adding context from the same pages. Tag 31 is partial because the cited page does not list all promoters (Rajesh is on page 156, which is correctly cited separately). One untagged claim about the issue structure (no offer for sale) should be cited. No unsupported or wrong-source tags were found, so the report's factual base is reliable.
